_readme: CTX-4's equivalence gate. Both the Rust assembly (agent/context.rs) and the TypeScript one (store.ts + context.ts) build a turn array from this input and must produce prompt-assembly.golden.txt byte for byte. If you change either implementation, this file and the golden must change with it, in the same commit. JSON strings are given as text, not as objects, because JavaScript keeps object keys in insertion order and serde_json sorts them: the point of the test is that neither side re-serializes them.
